description: Supporting diagrams as Mermaid or D2 source, each with a one-sentence caption and the beat range it supports. An empty list is a valid answer.

beatId.description: The beat the diagram enters on.

toBeatId.description: The last beat the diagram supports. Equal to beatId for one beat.

anchor.description: Where in beatId it enters. action: actionLabel names a recorded action. words: fromWord and toWord index the beat's spoken words.

actionLabel.description: The recorded action label when anchor is action, otherwise empty.

fromWord.description: First spoken word index in beatId (0-based). 0 when anchor is action.

toWord.description: Last spoken word index in beatId, inclusive. 0 when anchor is action.

source.description: The diagram source. About 7 to 12 nodes, labels of a few words.

caption.description: One sentence. It doubles as alt text.

placement.description: A side panel or picture-in-picture. fullscreen only at a natural pause with no action.

note.description: One short sentence for the reviewer.
